title: Value of the Refunded Installment for TRICARE Prime Duplicate Payment Refunds
content:
For the refund of a duplicate payment on a TRICARE Prime installment other than the first installment, the value of the refunded installment follows that installment's frequency.

| Refunded installment | Its value |
|---|---|
| a monthly installment | one twelfth of the annual fee of the enrollment's fee arrangement (the annual fee divided by 12), rounded to the cent |
| a quarterly installment | one quarter of that fee (the annual fee divided by 4), rounded to the cent |
| otherwise (an annual installment) | the whole annual fee |

The annual fee is the tier's annual individual fee for an individual arrangement and its annual family fee for a family arrangement.

## Hypothetical values, TRICARE Prime Retiree Group B family arrangement (annual fee 969.36)

| Refunded installment | Value |
|---|---|
| monthly | 80.78 |
| quarterly | 242.34 |
| annual | 969.36 |

Two payments of 80.78 against a monthly installment of that arrangement exceed its 80.78 value by 80.78.
